∀ {M : Type u_10} {N : Type u_11} [inst : AddZero M] [inst_1 : AddZero N] (self : M →+ N) (x y : M),
  (↑self).toFun (x + y) = (↑self).toFun x + (↑self).toFun y
items.informal_description: For any additive monoid homomorphism $ f : M →+ N $ between additive monoids with zero, and for all $ x, y ∈ M $, it holds that $ f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y) $. This expresses the fundamental property that additive monoid homomorphisms preserve the addition operation.

  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid S] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → AddZeroClass (β i)] (h : R →+ S) (f : Π₀ (i : ι), β i)
